defense_news.title: US Army helicopter pilots test new in-flight ‘relief’ system
defense_news.summary: The 101st Combat Aviation Brigade recently completed the Army’s first-ever helicopter test flights using the Advanced Inflight Relief Universal System.

defense_news.title: US Army gets first mobile cannon to replace M777 howitzer, officials say
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Army has taken delivery of its first Korean-made mobile tactical cannon less than a year after first issuing a solicitation.

defense_news.title: Vector, Nammo expand push to mass-produce armed drones
defense_news.summary: Executives from both companies say they’re scaling up production of systems that reflect “the realities of how warfighters will employ them.”

defense_news.title: US Army, Kaizen Laboratories to establish common software platform for classified material
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Army recently awarded $43 million to Kaizen Laboratories to create application software for highly sensitive military material.
